Секції можна робити на наступному уроці: You can do these sections in the next lesson as a warm-up. Before the first section, remind the pattern: who + is/are + action-ing. Hint for the match: is - one animal or person, are - several. The game has new words cow, horse, hen, duck, goat: show pictures and play "Animal sounds" (Moo, Neigh, Cluck, Quack, Maa). After the game the child makes sentences: The cow is sleeping. The ducks are swimming.

Можна використати як розминку на наступн: You can use this as a warm-up in the next lesson. Before the first section, draw the timeline again: a long action (was/were + -ing) and a short event (Past Simple). Tricky points: got lost is in Past Simple because it is one event; stood very still means did not move. In the translation different correct versions count (saw / noticed, amazing / beautiful); you can accept other logical answers manually. After the game, ask the student to continue 2-3 sentences with their own endings.

Формат як у НМТ: перша і третя секції -: The format is like the NMT: the first and third sections are multiple choice with four options. Teach the strategy: first find the time marker (since, for, last month, in 2015, so far, yet), then choose. Tricky points: "She has worked… and she still loves" - the action continues now, so Present Perfect; "Since then she has been abroad" - since then needs Present Perfect; "Has she ever been" - after has we need V3. In the V3 game the student answers orally first, then makes 2-3 sentences with I have… You can use this as a warm-up in the next lesson.
